note: At ~9,000 ft on the edge of a wetland meadow beside East Brush Creek, partly in mature spruce, with views of Craig Peak; beaver colony in the meadow. From Eagle (I-70 exit 147): Sylvan Lake Road, then about 9 miles up Brush Creek Road to the fork and 6 miles up East Brush Creek Road (FR 415). Trailheads nearby for the Lake Charles Trail into the Holy Cross Wilderness and Fulford Cave (permit; closed Oct 15 - Apr 15); the old mining town of Fulford is a few miles up FR 418. --Claude
